attack_paths.likelihood_rationale: [CRITICAL] External SaaS → Webhook Receiver → Event Queue → Data Transformer → Integration DB. Legitimate use: end user traverse path to reach Integration DB. If exploited: Gain initial access at External SaaS. Access Webhook Receiver via the initial entry point. Move from Webhook Receiver to Event Queue. Move from Event Queue to Data Transformer. Reach target Integration DB — exfiltrate, encrypt, or disrupt. Corroborated: user journey matches attack path.
